title: Hello Kitty Run sells out, expects 20,000 participants on Nov. 29
summary: The Hello Kitty Run is anticipating a huge turnout, with around 20,000 runners expected to participate the Sanrio-themed event, organizer RUNRIO announced on Thursday.
